fields.question_box: div.ashby-application-form-field-entry[data-field-path=<id>] holding label.ashby-application-form-question-title[for=<id>]; required marked by the class _required_ on the label (no star in the text)

yes_no.widget: div.ashby-application-form-input-yesno with two buttons (data-option=yes|no, aria-pressed=true|false) over a hidden checkbox named by the question id
yes_no.pick: click the button whose data-option (or text) is the answer; confirm aria-pressed=true on it
yes_no.gotcha: the checkbox that holds the answer is hidden (tabindex=-1): never judge the question unanswered from the checkbox alone

fields.choice: radio inputs with a <label> each (EEO: Gender, Race, Veteran Status); some forms use a combobox for Location

file.widget: input type=file accept=application/pdf,... ; TWO on the page: 'Autofill from resume' at the top, and the required 'Resume' field
file.fill: set_input_files on the input inside the field entry whose label is 'Resume'; the autofill one is optional and re-fills the form

fields.bot_trap: a hidden textarea labelled 'Name' -- never fill a field that is not visible
